desc:
🧠 Brainrot Trading!

✨ Collect your favorite Brainrots.
💎 Some Brainrots are way rarer than others!
🎰 Spin the Random Brainrot machine to grow your collection.
💰 Your Brainrots earn you cash every minute!
🤝 Trade with friends to build your dream inventory.

HOW TO TRADE:

1. Stand on a trading board with someone else.
2. Drop the Brainrots you want to trade on the table.
3. Both players jump on ✅ to accept.
4. Jump on ❌ to cancel.
5. Jump on ➕ to request more.

Happy Trading! 🧠🔥

📝1 - Credit: Steal a Brainrot (For the Model)
📝2 - Credit : Pop It Trading (For the Board Design)
